skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — cut the best 30-second clips from my long video for social media — and get...

latestVersion.changelog:
Clip Maker AI v1.0.0

- Initial release: Turn long videos into short, edited clips automatically using cloud AI.
- Supports uploads in MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM formats up to 500MB.
- Automated setup, including anonymous token generation and session management.
- Exports high-quality MP4s for TikTok and social media within 30-60 seconds.
- Simple API commands for upload, edit, export, credits, and status.
- Automatic error handling for expired tokens, large/unsupported files, credits, and rate limits.
